description: Samsung is expanding the One UI 8.5 update based on Android 16 to older flagship devices. Meanwhile, user reports suggest that the company has begun testing One UI 9, based on Android 17. This indicates that Samsung is moving faster than usual this year. Samsung is likely to make the One UI 9 beta available for more users after the completion of the wider rollout of One UI 8.5.
title: Samsung Reportedly Starts Internal Testing of Android 17-Based One UI 9 for Galaxy S25 Series

description: Tecno has confirmed that the Pova 8 will launch in India on June 11. The company has teased the smartphone's design, including an 8,000mAh battery and a new matrix-style lighting element integrated into the rear camera module. A Flipkart teaser suggests the handset will be sold through the e-commerce platform. Previous leaks indicate the phone could feature a MediaTek Dimensity 7100 chipset, Android 16, 45W fast charging, and up to 8GB RAM with 256GB storage.
title: Tecno Pova 8 India Launch Date Announced; Battery Size, Design, Colour Options Teased

description: OpenAI has detailed a new version of Dreaming, the technology that powers ChatGPT's memory features. The company said the system is better at retaining useful information, adapting to changing circumstances, and applying user preferences across conversations. OpenAI also introduced a memory management page and reported gains across multiple benchmark categories. According to the company, the latest architecture requires significantly fewer computing resources than before, helping support a broader rollout and increased memory capacity for subscribers.
title: OpenAI Introduces Smarter ChatGPT Memory, Adds Dreaming Architecture

description: Summer Game Fest 2026 will be broadcast live on Friday and the show promises to bring a ton of major reveals and announcements. Some games, like Blood Message and Star Wars Zero Company, are already confirmed for the show, but there will be several surprises. Here's what you can expect from Summer Game Fest 2026.
title: Summer Game Fest 2026: How to Watch, What to Expect

description: A rare angrite meteorite discovered in the Sahara may have come from a moon-sized protoplanet that existed 4.5 billion years ago. Its unusual minerals point to a large world that later disappeared in a catastrophic collision.
title: Sahara Meteorite May Be Fragment of a Lost Moon-Sized World, Study Suggests

description: Sattendru Maarudhu Vaanilai is a 2026 Tamil romantic thriller directed by Babu Vijay. Starring Jai Sampath and Meenakshi Govindarajan, the film revolves around a young couple who marry impulsively and soon face financial difficulties and life-threatening challenges.
title: Sattendru Maarudhu Vaanilai Now Streaming Online: Where to Watch Jai’s Romantic Thriller Movie

description: OnePlus Turbo 6X series will launch in China before June 18. As we wait for the formal reveal, OnePlus has shared new Weibo posters revealing the key specifications of the upcoming phones. They will be launched in 8GB + 128GB, 8GB + 256GB, and 12GB + 256GB RAM and storage options. The OnePlus Turbo 6X Pro will come with an 8,000mAh battery and a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Super chipset. The OnePlus Turbo 6X, on the other hand, is teased to come with a 7,000mAh battery and a MediaTek Dimensity 7300 Super chipset.
title: OnePlus Turbo 6X, OnePlus Turbo 6X Pro Colour Options, Price Range, Key Specifications Teased

description: Video consumption in India is no longer concentrated in metropolitan cities, according to a new study commissioned by Meta Platforms. The report revealed that Reels, Instagram’s short-form video content, is playing a growing role in content discovery, creator engagement, and even purchase decisions. As per the company, daily video engagement on its platforms has become almost identical across metro cities, tier-2 and tier-3 towns, and rural India, hinting towards a narrowing gap in video consumption between urban and rural areas.
title: Instagram Reels Influencing Nearly Half of Purchase Decisions in India, Meta Study Claims

description: Xiaomi Pad 8, which was released in India in March with the Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset, has become more expensive. The company has increased the price by Rs. 2,000 across variants. It has a 3.2K display and a 9,200mAh battery with fast-charging support. Now, the Xiaomi Pad 8 costs Rs. 35,999 for the sole 8GB RAM + 128GB storage model, marking a Rs. 2,000 increase from its launch price of Rs. 33,999.
title: Xiaomi Pad 8 Price Hiked in India: Here’s How Much It Costs Now

description: Bybit has integrated Western Union’s USDPT stablecoin, allowing users to hold, trade, and transfer the digital dollar on the exchange. The move expands USDPT’s reach beyond payments and into the crypto trading ecosystem.
title: Bybit Lists Western Union’s USDPT Stablecoin for Trading and Transfers

description: References to eight potential Googlebook devices were spotted in the Chromium code. The lineup could include four models with Intel chipsets, three Snapdragon-powered models, and one MediaTek-based variant. The Googlebook is designed on Gemini Intelligence and includes the Chrome browser and the Google Play Store. It is compatible with Android smartphones and offers features like the Magic Pointer. The Googlebook is confirmed to launch in this fall.
title: Googlebook Lineup Tipped to Include Eight Devices; Intel May Power Four Models

description: Insomniac Games has confirmed that Marvel's Wolverine will not be an open world or sandbox game. The PS5 exclusive will be a story-driven, single-player linear adventure. But players will get option content, including collectibles. Marvel's Wolverine will launch on PS5 on September 15.
title: Marvel's Wolverine Will Be a Linear Adventure, Not an Open World Game, Says Insomniac

description: FIFA World Cup: Launch Edition will launch exclusively on Netflix Games on June 11. The football title includes all participating teams and venues from the FIFA World Cup 2026 and supports smartphone-based controls on smart TVs. Local multiplayer allows up to four players to take part in matches. FIFA said the initial release focuses on accessibility and quick gameplay, while future updates are expected to introduce additional content and gameplay enhancements.
title: Netflix Games Launches FIFA World Cup: Launch Edition Ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026

description: The Asics GEL-Kayano 33 was launched in India on Friday as the latest addition to the flagship stability running shoe lineup. As per the company, the product builds upon the legacy of the GEL-Kayano series and brings upgraded cushioning for a more comfortable running experience. With the Asics GEL-Kayano 33, the brand has introduced a new FluidSupport technology that is claimed to work in tandem with dual-layer cushioning for enhanced stability.
title: Asics GEL-Kayano 33 Launched in India With New Stability Tech, FluidSupport System

description: Apple has started enforcing new age-verification requirements for App Store users in Texas following the implementation of SB 2420. New Apple Account applicants in the state must provide age-related information, while users under 18 require parental approval for app downloads, in-app purchases, and certain app changes. The company has also introduced new APIs, notifications, and developer tools to support compliance. Apple continues to oppose such laws, arguing that age-verification requirements could require companies to collect additional personal information from users.
title: Apple Rolls Out New App Store Age-Verification Rules for Texas Users Following Court Ruling

description: Apple is reportedly working on a new premium laptop that could come with MacBook Ultra branding. The device is rumoured to feature an OLED display and touchscreen functionality. A new report by market research firm Omdia has now shed more light on the potential launch timeline and display technology of the MacBook Ultra. It is said to launch in the third quarter of this year. Samsung Display will reportedly supply OLED panels for these 14.3-inch and 16.3-inch laptop models.
title: Apple's MacBook Ultra With OLED Screen Said to Launch Later This Year; Screen Sizes Suggested

description: Boat expanded its product portfolio in India with the launch of the new Slazer Series on Friday. The company says this move marks its entry into the personal grooming segment. Its latest lineup includes three products — Boat Slazer S100, Slazer K100+, and Slazer K100 Pro, geared towards consumers looking for beard, hair, nose, and body grooming solutions. The Boat Slazer K100+ is positioned as a 6-in-1 grooming kit with interchangeable attachments.
title: Boat Slazer Series Grooming Solutions Launched in India With Interchangeable Attachments, Travel Kit Bundle

description: Redmi Turbo 5 will be launched in India later this month, the company announced on Friday. The upcoming handset is positioned to be the first Turbo model launched by the Xiaomi subsidiary in the country. Alongside its launch date, the brand has also confirmed the processor details of the handset. It is claimed to be the fastest Redmi smartphone yet, while also packing the biggest battery on any Redmi phone to date.
title: Redmi Turbo 5 India Launch Date Announced; Confirmed to Feature MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Ultra Chip

description: The crypto market remained under pressure on Friday as Bitcoin traded near $61,800 amid continued ETF outflows and capital rotation into other sectors. Analysts said investors remain cautious ahead of upcoming US jobs data, inflation figures, and the Federal Reserve meeting.
title: Bitcoin Extends Decline to $62,000 as ETF Outflows and Capital Rotation Persist

description: Apple has added four new games to Apple Arcade and announced five more titles that will arrive later this month and in July. Mini Football Legends, My Talking Tom 2+, Coffee Inc 2+, and FreeCell Solitaire: Card Game+ are now available. Family Feud Pocket is set to launch on June 30, while Dungeon Clawler+, Creatures of the Deep+, Pocket City 2+, and Draw It+ will join the service on July 2. Apple Arcade currently offers more than 200 games without ads or in-app purchases.
title: New Apple Arcade Games Coming in June 2026: Here's the Full List

description: The OTT platforms have landed with a new set of movies and series, including Maa Behen, Dhurandhar: The Revenge, Gullak S5, and more.
title: New OTT Releases This Week (June 01 - June 07): Dhurandhar 2: The Revenge, Maa Behen, Office Romance, The Pyramid Scheme, and More

description: Valve has confirmed that Steam Machine and Steam Frame VR headset will begin shipping this summer. The company also expanded its Verified program for games to include the two upcoming devices. Steam Machine and Steam Frame have been delayed amidst ongoing memory and storage shortages.
title: Steam Machine and Steam Frame VR Headset Will Launch This Summer, Valve Says

description: Samsung is rumoured to launch its next-generation foldable smartphones at the Galaxy Unpacked event in July. A tipster has now revealed details about the upcoming clamshell-style foldable, ubiquitously known as the Galaxy Z Flip 8. The South Korean tech conglomerate is said to adopt a dual-chip strategy for the purported handset, similar to the flagship Galaxy S26 series. Consequently, the Galaxy Z Flip 8 may be offered with two different chipsets, depending on the market.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 Tipped to Launch With Exynos 2600 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Variants

description: A new leak suggests OnePlus is exploring significantly higher refresh rates for future flagship smartphones. According to a tipster, the company plans to continue using 1.5K displays while pushing refresh rates from 165Hz and 185Hz to as high as 240Hz. The tipster also indicated that OnePlus could revisit 2K panels if they can support such refresh rates efficiently. Recent reports suggest the upcoming OnePlus 16 may feature a 1.5K OLED display with a 185Hz refresh rate and Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chipset.
title: OnePlus Could Soon Pair a 2K Display With a 240Hz Refresh Rate

description: Google launched Search Profiles, designed for creators and publishers. Search profiles are a dedicated, shareable space to highlight content across platforms and help audiences find accurate, up-to-date information about sources on Search. Eligible creators can claim an existing profile automatically generated by Google or create a new one by linking their social media accounts.
title: Google Rolls Out Search Profiles for Publishers and Creators: Know How It Works

description: Google is rolling out its Gemini Avatar feature to a wider group of paid Gemini subscribers. It allows users to create an AI-powered digital version of themselves that can be used to generate videos and other content within Gemini. The feature is powered by Google’s Gemini Omni, Google’s new AI model that is claimed to be capable of generating anything from any input. First discovered during an APK teardown in March, Gemini Avatar is designed to replicate a user's appearance and voice.
title: Google Expands Gemini Avatar to More Paid Users, Lets You Generate AI Content Featuring Yourself

description: OnePlus Community Sale 2026 in India was announced on Thursday. The limited-period sale brings discounts, bank offers, and no-cost EMI options on a wide range of OnePlus products. The company has announced discounts on the flagship OnePlus 15 and OnePlus 15R, as well as the OnePlus 13 lineup, latest Nord smartphones, tablets, and audio products. Customers can avail of the offers through OnePlus India, Amazon, Flipkart, and select offline retail channels.
title: OnePlus Community Sale Brings Offers on OnePlus 15, OnePlus Nord 6, OnePlus Pad 4 and More
